title: Selling Plans — Credit Share for Late Seller Cancellations
content:
The later a seller cancels a captured order, the smaller the share of the variable final value fee a **Selling Plans** cancellation credit returns. Lateness is measured from the order's variable fee billing date to the date of the seller cancellation defect on the seller's Seller Performance Standing record.

**Rule.** The cancellation credit share is the near-late cancellation share when the seller cancellation defect is dated at least the near-late days but fewer than the far-late days after the order's variable fee billing date, the far-late cancellation share when it is dated at least the far-late days after, and the whole fee when it is dated fewer than the near-late days after; the cancellation credit before any administration fee is the creditable variable fee times that share, rounded to the nearest cent.

## Share by calendar days from billing to the cancellation defect

| Days after the variable fee billing date | Cancellation credit share |
|---|---|
| Fewer than 2 (0 or 1) | The whole fee |
| 2 or 3 (at least the near-late days of 2, fewer than the far-late days of 4) | 75% (near-late cancellation share) |
| 4 or more (the far-late days) | 50% (far-late cancellation share) |

## Hypothetical cases (variable fee billed on 10 August; creditable variable fee USD 26.40)

| Cancellation defect dated | Days | Share | Credit before any fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| 11 August | 1 | Whole | USD 26.40 |
| 12 August | 2 | 75% | USD 19.80 |
| 13 August | 3 | 75% | USD 19.80 |
| 14 August | 4 | 50% | USD 13.20 |
